integrity: Only the five Frobenius-fixed support polynomials and their 61-orbit S4 decomposition are claimed as new. The geometric 726-chamber total, its support polynomial and underlying negative-curve geometry are acknowledged prior results; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic at least five; smooth minimal resolution of the four-nodal Cayley cubic and its five finite-field forms. Arithmetic chambers are counted via geometrically Frobenius-stable negative supports; no claims for other cubic degenerations or characteristics two or three. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Frobenius descent and a 61-orbit classification of Zariski chambers on the Cayley cubic resolution
